issue.title: bob ref meet: dedicated Wispr Flow Copy-as-Markdown adapter built from a real paste fixture
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Add a dedicated Wispr Flow "Copy as Markdown" adapter to the `bob ref meet` notes normalizer (`src/native/meetings/normalize.rs`). The adapter should recognize Wispr's Markdown paste markup (`:::toggle` blocks and `<@speaker:N>` speaker tokens) and map it onto the existing `MeetingNotes` model (TL;DR, next steps, sections, transcript). It must keep the structure-only, wording-unchanged invariant.

Design it against a real paste fixture, never a guessed shape. Bryan should first be asked for one real "Copy as Markdown" paste. Only an anonymized, synthetic fixture with the same shape and invented names may enter the public repo. Until then, the generic Markdown path handles these pastes.

Source: the "Deferred" section of plan:202611/meeting_notes_event_refs.md (epic bob-cli-pw), and bob-cli-pw.6 note #5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: ask Bryan for a real Wispr Flow Copy as Markdown paste fixture).
